instruction: Use the Liquify filter's face-aware tools to modify facial features in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: GIMP's IWarp filter (similar to Liquify) does not have face-aware features or automatic facial feature detection. Photoshop's Liquify filter includes AI-powered face detection and tools specifically designed for facial features (eyes, nose, mouth, face shape). This advanced functionality is not available in GIMP.
